properties.title: HQ 12th Army Group Situation Map, to accompany G-3 Report No. 306, situation as of 071200 Apr. 1945 (SECRET; signed C. T. Schmidt for A. Franklin Kibler, Brigadier General, G.S.C., A.C. of S., G-3), at top right. The sheet also carries the base map's own heading (12th Army Group Outline Maps 1:1,000,000) and an Auth/Initials/Date box at top left (Date: 7 APRIL 1945)
